description:
FILED s526w1 (Opus, 2026-10-24) from the URI-5.34 board census (t/cwd.t, its only row).  PRE-EXISTING.

A program that sets `$ENV{PATH}` before a module is first needed loses every later RUN-TIME transpile: `p-transpile-file` (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp, ~27675) spawns pl2cl as `(sb-ext:run-program "perl" ... :search t)`, i.e. the first `perl` on the PROGRAM's PATH.  With PATH=/bin:/usr/bin that is the system perl (5.40.1 here) loading the perlbrew perl's Config.pm -- "Perl lib version (5.40.3) doesn't match executable" -- and the require dies "Failed to transpile .../lib/Cwd.pm".

REPRO (URI t/cwd.t, minimal):
    $ENV{PATH} = "/bin:/usr/bin";
    my $cwd = eval { require Cwd; Cwd::getcwd() };
    print defined $cwd ? "ok\n" : "died: $@";
  perl 5.40.3: ok
  PCL: died: Failed to transpile .../lib/Cwd.pm   (when Cwd is not yet cached)

Taint-style tests set PATH exactly like this, and so do daemons and setuid-ish scripts.  The fix is to spawn the perl PCL itself was started with (the absolute path the launcher resolved, as `$^X` is), never a PATH search; tools/install-pcl's wrappers already know it.

=== QUEUED (s530, Fable, 2026-10-31) ===
One of the 41 REAL whole-file CPAN board failures (the USER-asked review; 138 FAIL files = 69 perl-skips + 4 fixed + 2 perl-fails + 22 ruled not-supported + 41 real).  Queued as s531b member 4 (URI) -- `briefs-and-rules-for-claude-subagents/s530/s531a-prompt.md` / `s531b-prompt.md`.


=== DONE (s531d) ===
FIXED in cl/pcl-runtime.lisp: `*p-transpiler-perl*` = %p-perl-on-path (the truename of the first `perl` on $PATH) computed at LOAD time and again by an sb-ext:*init-hooks* entry at every image boot (a saved core would otherwise carry the build machine's answer, #2689's lesson) -- i.e. the PATH the PROCESS started with.  p-transpile-file and p-ensure-transpiler (the eval server) spawn it through one helper %p-run-transpiler-perl (no :search); NIL (no perl on the boot PATH) keeps the old `perl` + :search spawn.  The compiler stamp's perl half and `pcl --cache-info`'s "perl binary" line read the same variable, so the cache key cannot drift from the binary that transpiles.
Probe scratch/s531d/p/path1.pl (PATH=/bin:/usr/bin then require of an uncached module + Cwd + a string eval, cold PCL_CACHE_DIR): base dies "Failed to transpile" x2 + the eval server's "Perl lib version doesn't match executable"; tree = perl.
Guard: Pl/t/transpiler-perl-01.t (3 rows: the perl oracle, run 1 cold, run 2 warm; PATH points at a dir whose only `perl` is a failing stub, so the row means the same on CI where /usr/bin/perl IS the perl; rows 2-3 FAIL on ade297e7).  Board: URI cwd.t 1/0 one-file with a cold cache -> its row left by edit.


=== STATUS HELD in_progress (s531 end, the reviewing session): the batch that fixed this has NOT merged; CLOSE-WITH-ROWS -- the reviewing session sets completed in the merge commit, when the rows keyed on it leave main ===
subject: A program that sets $ENV{PATH} loses every later run-time module transpile: p-transpile-file spawns pl2cl as the first `perl` on the PROGRAM PATH (URI cwd.t)
